text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: ——...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —Eff! I knew you'd be here!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Let's go play together right now, 
Eff! Let's do it, we totally should!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the invitation, Epi-san. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Right now, to follow my destiny, I must 
read through all the books in the library.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, really? But the voice of destiny is 
telling me to go play~!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Alright! In that case, let's decide 
with our usual!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Rock, paper, scissors, go! Clip-clop, 
trot-trot, Jankenpyoi!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: —So. Where are we heading today?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I don't know! But don't worry! Coming here 
will surely reveal it!

text_block_list.name: Pigeon
text_block_list.text: —Coo, coo.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
! Eff, that's the one! Let's follow that 
pigeon!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I feel destiny calling from that 
plastic bag blowing in the wind! Let's 
chase it, Eff! And throw it in the trash 
while we're at it!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
...Is our destination still further ahead? 
I should head back soon to continue 
reading...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
We're almost there! For the sake of your 
destiny, trust me and come along!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: —Understood.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! Eff, this shop! I feel destiny from 
this shop! Let's go in!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ooh, Eff! They have pear tart!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: ! Pear...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You're getting this one, right? No, you 
definitely should! —Excuse me, clerk!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
(The sweetness of the pear is seeping 
right into my brain... ...I've been 
reading books since morning, after all...)

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: ...Delicious.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haha! Eff, you really do love pears!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: —...They hold special memories for me.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! That's wonderful! Seeing you 
happy makes me happy too, Eff!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Epi-san. Would you like a bite of 
the cake?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I do! I'll give you a bite of mine too! 
Let's eat a whole bunch before going back!

One day, when I went to the library to 
return some materials, I overheard a 
rather concerning conversation.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~! You can make ramen from scratch!? 
...I know! Eff, let's make pear ramen!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: Pear ramen... did you say?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! A 'destined' ramen that combines 
both our favorites! It'll definitely fire 
us up for training!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: I see. If that is the case...
choice_data_list: Isn't that combination a bit tricky...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's go make it right away! Is 
the Miho Dorm kitchen good?

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: Understood. I will reserve it.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll make a shopping list! Let's make 
plenty so everyone can have some!

...A few days later. Rumors reached me 
that Hishi Amazon's thunder had struck in 
the Miho Dormitory.

Startled by such a reckless combination, I 
couldn't help but speak up to them.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No need to worry! I'm blessed by 
destiny, after all!!
choice_data_list: Still, what if you get an upset stomach?
Still, what if you get an upset stomach?

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
—...Having our training hindered would 
certainly be undesirable.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Then let's rely on Cesario! She's great at 
cooking! Alright, let's go invite her! 
Right this second!

...A few days later. An unprecedented pear 
ramen craze swept through the academy.
